definitions.explanation: Rock or mineral from which metal or valuable minerals can be extracted. A key term in mining and geology.

examples.japanese: {鉱石|こうせき}を{採掘|さいくつ}する。
この{山|やま}からは{鉄|てつ}の{鉱石|こうせき}が{取|と}れる。
examples.english: Iron ore can be extracted from this mountain.

examples.japanese: {鉱石|こうせき}の{輸入|ゆにゅう}に{頼|たよ}っている{国|くに}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many countries depend on importing ore.

examples.japanese: {鉱石|こうせき}を{精錬|せいれん}して{金属|きんぞく}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Metals are extracted by refining ore.

notes:
Compound of {鉱|こう} (mine/mineral) and {石|せき} (stone). A fundamental term in geology, mining, and industry. Japan historically imported most of its ore, making {鉱石|こうせき} a common word in discussions of trade and resources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄鉱石|てっこうせき}: iron ore
- {銅鉱石|どうこうせき}: copper ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}を{採掘|さいくつ}する: to mine ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}を{精錬|せいれん}する: to refine ore
- {鉱石|こうせき}ラジオ: crystal radio — a simple radio receiver using a crystal detector

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉱物|こうぶつ}: mineral — a broader category; all ores are minerals but not all minerals are ores
- {宝石|ほうせき}: gemstone; jewel — a precious or decorative stone, different purpose than ore
- {原石|げんせき}: raw stone; uncut gem — an unprocessed stone, especially a gemstone before cutting
